prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Choice Redesign: Redesign the onboarding welcome story into a continuous story scroll layout leading directly into companion path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Scroll through the origin story to choose how you want to create your new pet companion."}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Path Preview Screen: Insert a new companion preview screen before path selection showcasing differences between instant adoption and custom generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_preview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_preview": {"headline": "Explore Your Pet Choices", "body": "Select ready-made companions for instant fun, or upload photos to craft a unique pet.", "layout": "two_column"}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Before Adoption Certificate Reorder: Move sign-in step to immediately follow photo upload/pet choice before generating the adoption certificate.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Spotlight Home Intro Redesign: Redesign the home_intro completion view into a spotlight layout that focuses attention on your newly spawned desktop companion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Companion Has Arrived!", "body": "Look closely at your desktop screen. Your pet companion is now active and exploring."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Recovery Hint: Add a prominent persistence hint on the sign-in screen informing users how logging in safeguards pet data across installs.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in binds your pet creations to your cloud profile so your companions are never lost."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Time Estimate: Display explicit progress counters and time estimates while waiting for pet companion generation on the home waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Generating Your Desktop Companion", "body": "We are assembling your pet graphics. Estimated rendering time is under 3 minutes."}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Reassurance Copy: Update the body text on choose_path screen to clarify that additional pets and custom options can be unlocked anytime later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Companion Path", "body": "Choose an instant adoption or create a custom pet. You can adopt more companions later!"}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Prompt: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Enable desktop alerts so you know immediately when your pet is ready to play."}}
8: [adoption, layout] Card Layout Adoption Certificate: Switch adoption_certificate screen layout to card layout to clearly structure companion details and final confirmation action.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Companion Adoption Certificate", "body": "Confirm your pet companion details below to finalize adoption."}}
9: [finish, new_screen] Companion Mastery Intro Screen: Add a new screen at the end of onboarding highlighting primary interaction shortcuts like right-clicking and hiding your pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_companion_mastery"], "new_companion_mastery": {"headline": "Mastering Desktop Companion Controls", "body": "Right-click your companion on the desktop anytime to open quick actions, mute sound, or trigger special animations.", "layout": "compact"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while keeping path choice intact is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a preview screen before path selection is allowed, and all required onboarding steps are preserved in order.
Reordering sign-in after photo upload is explicitly permitted by Rule 4, preserving all steps.
Redesigning the home_intro overlay within onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding an account persistence hint on the sign-in screen is valid and does not violate any rules.
Showing time estimates and progress counters for real background pet generation is permitted.
Reassurance copy on choose_path maintains the required choices without mentioning prices, discounts, or free extras.
Enabling optional notification prompts during the waiting screen is permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigning the adoption certificate into a card layout retains the job of showing adoption details.
Adding a new onboarding screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
